descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Operations & Standards - Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices. - Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels. - Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards. - Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence. Guest Experience & Quality Assurance - Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements. - Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering. - Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs. Training & Leadership Development - Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy. - Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning. Human Resources & Leadership Oversight - Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel. - Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet. - Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership. - Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required. Financial Oversight - Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet. - Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams. Your Journey so far - Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations. - At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations. - Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight. Your Essentials Leadership & Communication - Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams. - Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset. Technical & Operational Knowledge - Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems. - Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards. - Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards. Professional Competencies - Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen. - Results-driven, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative. - Capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Culinary Leadership - Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy. - Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices. - Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs. - Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects. Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance - Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required. - Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels. - Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements. - Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols. - Oversee beverage order and loading coordination. Training & Leadership Development - Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs. - Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards. - Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions. Human Resources & Team Management - Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness. - Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing. - Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet. - Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership. Financial Oversight - Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management. - Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department. - Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning. - Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department. Your Journey so far - Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills. - At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations. - Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management. Your Essentials Leadership & Communication - Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams. - Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset. Technical & Operational Knowledge - Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems. - Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations. - Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards. Professional Competencies - Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen. - Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and guest experience-focused. - Strong collaborator capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams. descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Vice President Global SPA and Wellness è il proprietario di business globale per tutte le operazioni di SPA, benessere, bellezza e fitness a bordo della Divisione Crociera di MSC Group, che comprende MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) e Explora Journeys (Luxury). Il ruolo ha piena responsabilità per i programmi SPA e di trattamento, aree fitness e termali, servizi di salone, vendita al dettaglio benessere, estetica medica (dove applicabile), e future offerte di benessere digitale. Questa posizione garantisce che gli standard di lusso per il benessere, i rituali di servizio, l'eccellenza terapeutica e le filosofie olistiche per il benessere siano completamente incorporati, in particolare per Explora Journeys, pur mantenendo ambienti benessere scalabili e differenziati dal marchio in tutta la flotta. Il VP definisce la visione globale di SPA e benessere a lungo termine, spinge le prestazioni commerciali, eleva la soddisfazione degli ospiti, ed evolve concetti di benessere che differenziano la Divisione Crociera di MSC Group attraverso segmenti contemporanei, premium e di lusso. Il tuo impatto Leadership strategica e commerciale - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di SPA e benessere attraverso marchi contemporanei, premium e di lusso, allineati con profili ospiti differenziati e posizionamento del marchio. - Agire come proprietario di business per Global SPA e Wellness, con responsabilità esplicita per i concetti e gli standard di lusso. - Proprio la roadmap commerciale end-to-end, tra cui l'architettura del trattamento, la strategia dei prezzi, le promozioni, l'ottimizzazione della capacità e la progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti end-to-end. - Condurre trattative strategiche con gli operatori SPA, partner benessere, fornitori di estetica medica (dove consentito), marchi di prodotto e fornitori di attrezzature. - Crescita dell'azionamento in categorie di benessere ad alto livello e premium, tra cui trattamenti firma, estetica medica, programmi di fitness e longevità, vendita al dettaglio di benessere e viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Sviluppare framework SPA e wellness scalabili ma distinguibili, consentendo la distribuzione selettiva di concetti premium e di lusso attraverso MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys. Eccellenza operativa e di marca - Superare le operazioni SPA a livello di flotta, assicurando la fornitura di servizi coerenti, la qualità del trattamento, gli standard igienici e la soddisfazione degli ospiti. - Definire standard di servizio, requisiti di certificazione terapeutica, programmi di formazione e benchmark di prestazioni in tutti i formati SPA. - Assicurare l'eccellenza del benessere di lusso per i viaggi Explora, inclusi rituali di servizio, condotta terapeutica, programmazione olistica, norme sulla privacy e ambienti benessere immersivi. - Introdurre concetti di benessere specifici, rituali di firma e lusso, programmazione esperienziale e trattamenti ispirati alla destinazione. - Assicurare la disponibilità della flotta per nuove costruzioni e banchine a secco, tra cui progettazione di layout SPA, selezione di attrezzature, pianificazione CAPEX e attivazione del concetto. Gestione finanziaria - Possedere la P&L completa per SPA e Wellness in tutti i marchi della Divisione Crociera, inclusi budget annui, target di ricavi, miglioramento dei margini e controllo dei costi. - Ottimizzare la produttività del terapeuta, il mix di trattamento, la disciplina dei prezzi, i tassi di attaccamento al dettaglio, i modelli di personale e l'economia di concessione. - Leva analisi avanzate per guidare la previsione della domanda, la gestione dei rendimenti, la segmentazione degli ospiti, l'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni e le prestazioni del trattamento. Collaborazione trasversale - Partner a stretto contatto con i team Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance e Newbuild per integrare il benessere nell'esperienza complessiva degli ospiti. - Collabora con i team CRM e Digital nell'impegno pre-cruise wellness, nell'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni a bordo e nei viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Allineare le offerte SPA con itinerario, destinazione e programmazione a bordo per massimizzare la differenziazione di rilevanza e le entrate. Leadership & Sviluppo organizzativo - Guidare un QQ globale e la flotta SPA e l'organizzazione benessere, tra cui team di strategia, operazioni, formazione e gestione dei partner. - Costruisci una cultura dell'eccellenza del servizio guest-centric, della gestione del benessere di lusso, della disciplina commerciale e dell'innovazione continua. - Mentor senior leader e rafforzare le capacità tra le operazioni SPA, lo sviluppo del concetto di benessere di lusso e la gestione delle prestazioni guidata dai dati. Il tuo viaggio finora - 15+ anni di esperienza di leadership senior in SPA, benessere, ospitalità, crociera, o multi-sito servizi business. - Proven successo proprietario di P&L complessi e la redditività di guida in ambienti orientati al servizio. - Profonda competenza nelle operazioni SPA, programmazione del benessere, gestione della qualità dei servizi e standard di esperienza degli ospiti di lusso. - Forte esperienza nella gestione di operatori di terze parti, modelli di concessione, o partnership di fornitori globali. I tuoi essenziali - Eccellente leadership, negoziazione e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder interfunzionali. - Volontà di viaggiare e operare in un ambiente internazionale veloce. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Your Impact Strategic & Commercial Leadership - Define and lead the global SPA and wellness strategy across contemporary, premium, and luxury brands, aligned with differentiated guest profiles and brand positioning. - Act as business owner for Global SPA and Wellness, with explicit accountability for luxury wellness concepts and standards. - Own the end-to-end commercial roadmap, including treatment architecture, pricing strategy, promotions, capacity optimisation, and end-to-end guest journey design. - Lead strategic negotiations with SPA operators, wellness partners, medical aesthetics providers (where permitted), product brands, and equipment suppliers. - Drive growth in high-margin and premium wellness categories, including signature treatments, medical aesthetics, fitness and longevity programs, wellness retail, and personalised wellbeing journeys. - Develop scalable yet brand-distinct SPA and wellness frameworks, enabling selective deployment of premium and luxury concepts across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys. Operational and Brand Excellence - Oversee SPA operations fleet-wide, ensuring consistent service delivery, treatment quality, hygiene standards, and guest satisfaction. - Define service standards, therapist certification requirements, training programs, and performance benchmarks across all SPA formats. - Ensure luxury wellness excellence for Explora Journeys, including service rituals, therapist conduct, holistic programming, privacy standards, and immersive wellness environments. - Introduce tier-specific wellness concepts, signature and luxury rituals, experiential programming, and destination-inspired treatments. - Ensure fleet readiness for newbuilds and dry docks, including SPA layout design, equipment selection, CAPEX planning, and concept activation. Financial Management - Own the full P&L for SPA and Wellness across all Cruise Division brands, including annual budgets, revenue targets, margin improvement, and cost control. - Optimise therapist productivity, treatment mix, pricing discipline, retail attachment rates, staffing models, and concession economics. - Leverage advanced analytics to drive demand forecasting, yield management, guest segmentation, booking optimisation, and treatment performance. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance, and Newbuild teams to integrate wellness into the overall guest experience. - Collaborate with CRM and Digital teams on pre-cruise wellness engagement, onboard booking optimisation, and personalised wellness journeys. - Align SPA offerings with itinerary, destination, and onboard programming to maximise relevance differentiation, and revenue. Leadership & Organisational Development - Lead a global HQ and fleet SPA and wellness organisation, including strategy, operations, training, and partner management teams. - Build a culture of guest-centric service excellence, luxury wellness stewardship, commercial discipline, and continuous innovation. - Mentor senior leaders and strengthen capabilities across SPA operations, luxury wellness concept development, and data-driven performance management. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior leadership experience in SPA, wellness, hospitality, cruise, or multi-site service businesses. - Proven success owning complex P&Ls and driving profitability in service-led environments. - Deep expertise in SPA operations, wellness programming, service quality management, and luxury guest experience standards. - Strong experience managing third-party operators, concession models, or global vendor partnerships. Your Essentials - Excellent leadership, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills. - Willingness to travel extensively and operate in a fast-paced international environment. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Vice President Global SPA and Wellness ist der weltweite Geschäftsinhaber für alle an Bord von SPA, Wellness, Schönheit und Fitness-Operationen über die Cruise Division von MSC Group, über MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) und Explora Journeys (Luxury). descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre objectif Le vice-président Global SPA and Wellness est le propriétaire d'entreprise mondial pour toutes les opérations de SPA, de bien-être, de beauté et de fitness à bord de la division Croisières du groupe MSC, couvrant MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) et Explora Journeys (Luxury). Le rôle consiste à rendre pleinement compte des programmes de SPA et de traitement, des zones de conditionnement physique et thermique, des services de salon, de la vente au détail de bien-être, de l'esthétique médicale (le cas échéant) et des futures offres de bien-être numérique. Cette position garantit que les normes de bien-être de luxe, les rituels de service, l'excellence thérapeutique et les philosophies de bien-être holistiques sont entièrement intégrés, en particulier pour Explora Journeys, tout en maintenant des cadres de bien-être évolutifs et différenciés par la marque dans l'ensemble de la flotte. Le VP définit la vision globale à long terme du SPA et du bien-être, stimule la performance commerciale, élève la satisfaction des clients et développe des concepts de bien-être qui différencient la division Croisière du MSC sur les segments contemporains, premium et luxe. Votre impact Leadership stratégique et commercial - Définissez et dirigez la stratégie globale de SPA et de bien-être pour les marques contemporaines, premium et de luxe, alignées sur des profils d'invités différenciés et le positionnement de la marque. - Oui. Agir en tant que propriétaire d'entreprise pour Global SPA et Wellness, avec une responsabilité explicite pour les concepts et les normes de bien-être de luxe. - Posséder la feuille de route commerciale de bout en bout, y compris l'architecture de traitement, la stratégie de tarification, les promotions, l'optimisation des capacités, et la conception de voyage de bout en bout. - Diriger les négociations stratégiques avec les opérateurs de SPA, les partenaires de bien-être, les fournisseurs d'esthétique médicale (si possible), les marques de produits et les fournisseurs d'équipement. - Favoriser la croissance dans les catégories de bien-être haut de gamme et haut de gamme, y compris les traitements de signature, l'esthétique médicale, les programmes de conditionnement physique et de longévité, le commerce de détail de bien-être et les voyages personnalisés de bien-être. - Développer des cadres de SPA et de bien-être évolutifs mais distincts, permettant un déploiement sélectif de concepts haut de gamme et de luxe à travers MSC Cruises et Explora Journeys. Excellence en matière d'exploitation et d'image de marque - Surveiller les opérations de SPA dans toute la flotte, en assurant une prestation de services uniforme, la qualité du traitement, les normes d'hygiène et la satisfaction des clients. - Définir les normes de service, les exigences de certification des thérapeutes, les programmes de formation et les repères de rendement pour tous les formats de SPA. - Assurer l'excellence en bien-être de luxe pour Explora Journeys, y compris les rituels de service, la conduite des thérapeutes, la programmation holistique, les normes de confidentialité et les environnements de bien-être immersifs. - Introduire des concepts de bien-être spécifiques, des rituels de signature et de luxe, une programmation expérientielle et des traitements inspirés de la destination. - Assurer l'état de préparation de la flotte pour les nouvelles constructions et les cales sèches, y compris la conception de l'aménagement du SPA, la sélection de l'équipement, la planification du CAPEX et l'activation du concept. descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Preparare estrazioni di dati, grafici, tabelle e uscite analitiche di primo livello utilizzando modelli standardizzati.

- Mantenere i tracker di analisi del Customer Journey, assicurando la documentazione corretta, il controllo della versione e il monitoraggio dei piani di azione.

- Supporta analisi e aggiornamenti di follow-up dopo i piloti, modifiche operative o feedback di gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

- Consolidare e analizzare i dati provenienti da più fonti, inclusi i sondaggi di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, il feedback dei nostri clienti, la formazione di NPS e i relativi indicatori degli ospiti.

- Costruire, aggiornare e mantenere le dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del programma, l'impegno e l'impatto nel tempo.

- Produrre rapporti regolari di performance e riassunti esecutivi strutturati per le recensioni di leadership.

- Assicurare la coerenza dei dati, la precisione e gli standard di report in tutti i nostri output di analisi BEST.

- Sostenere la preparazione di visualizzazioni di dati e materiali di storytelling per gli stakeholder senior.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea (o attualmente iscritta) in Business, Data Analytics, Ospitalità o un campo relativo

- Forte mentalità analitica con attenzione ai dettagli

- Avanzate competenze di Excel; la conoscenza degli strumenti di dashboard (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau) è un plus

- Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre i dati in insight strutturati

- Fluente in inglese

I tuoi essenziali

Competenze consigliate

- No.
Conoscenza di base delle metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e NPS

- No.
Comprensione di base delle metriche di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti

- Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione e reporting dati

- Interessi nel viaggio dei clienti, nell'esperienza degli ospiti e nel miglioramento dei servizi

- Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati dell'indagine e l'analisi a risposta aperta

Cosa ti offre questo ruolo:

- Esperienza pratica nell'analisi, sviluppo KPI e dashboard

- Esposizione all'impatto reale del business attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati

- Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre but

Rejoignez MSC Cruises pour un stage passionnant axé sur l'analyse, le suivi des performances et la génération de perspicaces dans deux domaines stratégiques : le parcours client et notre meilleur programme.

Ce rôle est idéal pour une personne passionnée par l'analyse des données, la génération de connaissances et la création de tableaux de bord, qui s'intéresse vivement à l'amélioration de l'expérience des employés et des invités grâce à un impact mesurable.

Vous soutiendrez le développement d'analyses structurées et de mécanismes de suivi, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le service Voyage client et RH. Ce rôle permet d'être directement exposé aux analyses axées sur les clients et les employés.

Votre impact

Voyage client:

- Soutenir les analyses récurrentes du parcours client, y compris les examens sur toile, les analyses en milieu de saison par navire et les produits livrables du comité.

- Contribuer à des analyses ad hoc sur des sujets précis, des segments invités, des nationalités ou des navires, en fonction des demandes d'affaires et de gestion.

- Préparer des extractions de données, des graphiques, des tableaux et des résultats analytiques de premier niveau à l'aide de modèles normalisés.

- Tenir des traceurs d'analyse du parcours client, assurer la documentation appropriée, le contrôle des versions et le suivi des plans d'action.

- Appuyer les analyses de suivi et les mises à jour après les projets pilotes, les changements opérationnels ou la rétroaction de la direction.

- Veiller à l'exactitude, à l'uniformité et à l'alignement des données sur les produits livrables et les rapports du Programme Voyage client.

Notre programme BEST:

- Soutenir le développement, la maintenance et le suivi des cadres KPI pour le programme NOTRE MEILLEUR.

- Consolider et analyser les données provenant de sources multiples, y compris les enquêtes sur l'engagement des employés, NOTRE meilleure rétroaction, la formation des NPF et les indicateurs pertinents des invités.

- Créer, mettre à jour et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord pour surveiller l'exécution, l'engagement et l'impact du programme au fil du temps.

- Produire régulièrement des rapports sur le rendement et des résumés structurés pour les examens des dirigeants.

- Assurer la cohérence des données, l'exactitude et les normes de rapport pour tous nos meilleurs résultats analytiques.

- Soutenir la préparation de visualisations de données et de matériel de narration pour les acteurs de haut niveau.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Diplôme (ou actuellement inscrit) en Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, ou un domaine connexe

- Forte mentalité analytique avec attention aux détails

- Compétences Excel avancées; la connaissance des outils de tableau de bord (p. ex. Power BI, Tableau) est un plus

- Fortes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de traduire les données en idées structurées

- Fluent en anglais

Vos essentiels

Compétences privilégiées

- Oui.
Compréhension de base des paramètres de satisfaction des clients et des NPS

- Oui.
Connaissance de base des paramètres de la participation des employés

- Expérience de la visualisation des données et des outils de rapport

- Intérêt pour le voyage client, l'expérience client et l'amélioration du service

- Connaissance de l'analyse des données d'enquête et de l'analyse des commentaires ouverts

Ce que ce rôle vous offre :

- Expérience pratique en analyse, développement KPI et tableau de bord

- Exposition à un impact commercial réel grâce à la prise de décisions fondées sur les données

- Possibilité de travailler dans un environnement mondial et dynamique

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. Your Impact - Act as the primary HR partner for assigned corporate functions, providing strategic advice and operational HR support aligned with business objectives; - Equip leaders with the tools, frameworks, and guidance required to effectively manage their teams in line with Group values and people policies; - Partner with senior leaders to support workforce planning and organisational needs, ensuring capabilities and capacity are aligned with current and future business requirements; - Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define recruitment needs and support delivery of hiring plans in line with agreed KPIs; - Drive performance and accountability by supporting the implementation of the Group performance management framework, including goal setting, evaluation cycles, and manager capability building; - Support talent management processes within the business perimeter, including talent reviews, identification of high-potential employees, succession discussions, and development actions, in coordination with the Head of HR and relevant Centers of Expertise; - Advise managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant people decisions; - Support change management and organisational initiatives by assessing people impact, supporting leaders through transitions, and ensuring clear and effective communication; - Contribute to key HR cycles such as annual compensation reviews, talent reviews, and employee engagement initiatives; - Work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and HRIS teams to ensure smooth execution of HR processes and digital tools; - Participate in global HR projects and initiatives, contributing business insight and supporting effective local implementation; - Conduct exit interviews, analyse turnover trends, and contribute to retention and engagement actions within the business perimeter. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; - Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience in a matrixed, multinational environment, including at least 5 -7 years in a Senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role; - Proven HR experience within the hospitality, cruise, travel or customer-centric industry, with a strong understanding of service culture; - Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders in a corporate or headquarters environment; - Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver HR initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines; - Solid exposure to performance management, talent processes, employee relations, and organisational support; - Experience working with global HR policies, frameworks, and HR systems (HRIS); - Knowledge of Swiss Labour Law is an advantage; - Fluent in English; French is an advantage. Your Essentials - Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into pragmatic HR solutions; - Credible and confident advisor, able to influence, challenge, and build trust with senior stakeholders; - Strong understanding of hospitality and service excellence cultures, with the ability to balance people care, performance, and operational demands; - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. - Structured, reliable, and comfortable operating across multiple priorities; - Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across HR functions and with diverse stakeholders; - High standards of integrity, discretion, and professional judgment; - Flexible, resilient, and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

titleByLocale.it: Direttore delle Operazioni - Infrastrutture di accoglienza

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Your Impact 1. Operational Leadership Across the Asset Lifecycle Own end-to-end operational responsibility from pre-opening through live operations. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability. Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direct daily operations across all departments (hospitality, F&B, retail, attractions, marine, security, maintenance, guest services). Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operational P&L, cost controls and productivity metrics. Manage operating budgets, capex planning and lifecycle reserves. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior operations leadership in hospitality, cruise destinations, resorts, ports, theme parks or large hospitality assets. - Demonstrated ownership of both pre-opening and long-term operations. - Strong background working alongside development, construction and technical services teams. - Experience in Caribbean or island environments strongly preferred. Your Essentials - Operational readiness & lifecycle operations - Large-scale workforce leadership - Financial & P&L accountability - Asset lifecycle & maintenance management - Multi-operator and concession management Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Operationsdirektor ist verantwortlich für das Design, die Mobilisierung, die Eröffnung und den laufenden Betrieb von großen Kreuzfahrt- und Gastfreundschaft-Infrastrukturanlagen. Die Rolle sorgt für Kontinuität von der Entwicklung durch stationäre Operationen, die als Betriebsinhaber von frühen Bauphasen durch langfristige Leistung fungieren. Parallel zur Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Gasterfahrung garantiert der Leiter der Geschäftstätigkeit, dass die Vermögenswerte durch Design, vollständig bereit zur Eröffnung und nachhaltig effizient, sicher und profitabel sind. Ihre Auswirkungen 1. Operationelle Führung über den Asset Lifecycle Eigene operative End-to-End-Verantwortung von der Voröffnung durch Live-Operationen. Definieren Sie die Langzeit-Betriebsvision, Kennzahlen und Servicestandards. Gewährleistung der Kontinuität von Design, Kultur und Systemen von der Projektphase bis hin zu stationären Betrieben. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Führen Sie das betriebsbereite Programm im Einklang mit Bau Meilensteinen. In Abstimmung mit Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.) definieren Sie die Beschaffungsbedürfnisse und implementieren sie. FFE/OWS. Einflussentscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Sicherheit und Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit. Stellen Sie operative Strukturen, SOPs und Governance vor der Eröffnung fest. Manage Handover von Bau zu Betrieb, einschließlich phased Umsatz. Für jedes Projekt sorgen Personalbedarf und - in Verbindung mit Personal - die operativen Fähigkeiten neuer Vermögenswerte. Ausbildungsprogramme für Betriebsbereitschaft einrichten. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direkte tägliche Operationen in allen Abteilungen (Krankheit, F&B, Einzelhandel, Attraktionen, Marine, Sicherheit, Wartung, Gastdienste). Vergewissern Sie sich die Lieferung von Gästeerlebnis, Sicherheit, Servicequalität und Markenstandards. Führen Sie die Betriebsstabilität während der Hoch- und Reifephase aus. Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Teams zur Optimierung des Umsatzes (F&B, Einzelhandel, Erfahrungen, Küstenausflüge, gegebenenfalls). 6. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Directeur des opérations est responsable de la conception, de la mobilisation, de l'ouverture et de l'exploitation continue de grands équipements de croisière et d'accueil. Ce rôle assure la continuité du développement par des opérations en état d'équilibre, agissant en tant que propriétaire opérationnel depuis les premières phases de construction jusqu'à la performance à long terme. Parallèlement au développement, à la construction et à l'expérience des invités, le Directeur des opérations garantit que les actifs sont exploitables par la conception, prêts à l'ouverture et durables, sûrs et rentables par la suite. 1. Leadership opérationnel Tout au long du cycle de vie de l'actif Responsabilité opérationnelle de bout en bout de la préouverture à des opérations réelles. Définir la vision opérationnelle à long terme, les ICR et les normes de service. Assurer la continuité de la conception, de la culture et des systèmes depuis la phase du projet jusqu'aux opérations en état d'équilibre. 2. Préouverture et mobilisation (parallèle à la construction) Diriger le programme de préparation opérationnelle aligné sur les étapes de construction. En coordination avec les Services invités (F&B, HK, Entertainment, etc.), définir les besoins en matière d'approvisionnement et les mettre en oeuvre. - Oui. Influencer les décisions de conception pour assurer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la sécurité et la maintenance. Établir les structures opérationnelles, les PON et la gouvernance bien avant l'ouverture. Gérer les transferts de la construction à l'exploitation, y compris les roulements échelonnés. Pour chaque projet, déterminer les besoins en personnel et, de concert avec les RH, assurer la capacité opérationnelle des nouveaux biens. Établir des programmes de formation pour la préparation opérationnelle. 3. Gestion des opérations après l'ouverture Diriger les opérations quotidiennes dans tous les ministères (hôpital, F&B, détail, attractions, maritime, sécurité, entretien, services aux clients). Assurer la livraison de l'expérience client, la sécurité, la qualité du service et les normes de marque. Conduire la stabilité opérationnelle pendant les phases de montée en puissance et de maturité. Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble de l'actif. 4. Main-d'œuvre, formation et culture Construisez, dirigez et maintenez une main-d'oeuvre multinationale hautement performante. Maintenir et développer les programmes de formation après l'ouverture. Intégrer une culture axée sur la sécurité, le service et la performance. 5. Rendement financier et commercial Propre P&L opérationnelle, contrôle des coûts et indicateurs de productivité. Gérer les budgets d'exploitation, la planification du capex et les réserves du cycle de vie. Collaborer avec des équipes commerciales pour optimiser les revenus (F&B, détail, expériences, excursions à terre, le cas échéant). 6. Conformité, sécurité et gestion des risques Assurer la conformité continue à toutes les normes réglementaires, maritimes, sanitaires, de sécurité et environnementales. Diriger la préparation aux situations d'urgence, la gestion des crises et la planification de la continuité des opérations. Servir de cadre supérieur responsable pour les vérifications et les inspections. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 15 ans et plus leadership des opérations seniors dans l'hospitalité, les destinations de croisière, les stations balnéaires, les ports, les parcs à thème ou les grands actifs d'accueil. - Démonstration de la propriété des opérations avant l'ouverture et à long terme. - Forte expérience en collaboration avec les équipes de développement, de construction et de services techniques. - L'expérience dans les Caraïbes ou les îles est fortement préférée. Vos essentiels - Préparation opérationnelle et fonctionnement du cycle de vie - Leadership à grande échelle de la main-d'oeuvre - Responsabilité financière et P&L - Cycle de vie des actifs et gestion de l'entretien - Multi-exploitant et gestion des concessions Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les perspectives diverses, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être son authentique soi. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario. Il tuo scopo Il Destination Experience Manager è pienamente responsabile per le prestazioni, lo sviluppo e l'eccellenza operativa delle regioni assegnate. Questo ruolo richiede una forte esperienza di crociera sulle coste, una profonda conoscenza dei porti e della logistica di destinazione, e una solida comprensione delle operazioni a bordo. Il Manager sovrintende al ciclo di vita completo delle esperienze di destinazione, dal sourcing e dal contrarsi alla consegna a bordo e alle prestazioni finanziarie. Il tuo impatto Destinazione e gestione dei prodotti
• Sviluppare e gestire le esperienze di destinazione nelle regioni assegnate
• Scout e contrarre TOs/DMC attraverso offerte strutturate e trattative
• Assicurarsi che le esperienze siano fattibili e allineate agli standard del marchio di lusso
• Gestione dei prezzi, ROI e pianificazione delle capacità
• Superare il coordinamento dei contenuti con il Marketing e il caricamento del sistema (Seaware, Otalio, ecc.) Supporto operativo onboard &
• Assicurare che i prodotti riflettano le realtà a bordo (timing, demografie degli ospiti, considerazioni sulla mobilità)
• Treno e supporto a bordo
• Assistere con escalation, rimborsi e recupero dei servizi quando necessario
• Monitorare il feedback degli ospiti e implementare azioni correttive Gestione finanziaria e delle prestazioni
• Prestito bilancio e rendimento delle entrate per le regioni assegnate
• Monitorare i margini, le tendenze del rimborso e il contributo a livello di viaggio
• Identificare le porte sottoperformanti e ottimizzare le offerte di conseguenza
• Partner con Finance e Analytics per report e dashboard Il tuo viaggio finora - 7–10+ anni di escursioni in crociera lungo la costa, gestione della destinazione o viaggio di lusso - Corso di laurea in Ospitalità, Turismo, Business o esperienza equivalente preferito. I tuoi essenziali - Forte esperienza di crociera a bordo e comprensione operativa - Conoscenza profonda dei porti e delle infrastrutture di destinazione - La conoscenza delle regioni dell'Alaska, dei Caraibi, del Sud America o dell'Asia è un forte vantaggio - Prove capacità di negoziazione e gestione finanziaria - Forte capacità analitiche e di comunicazione - Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un bene - Valido permesso di lavoro svizzero o idoneità al lavoro in Svizzera / permesso USA per la posizione di Miami A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose The Destination Experience Manager is fully responsible for the performance, development, and operational excellence of assigned regions. This role requires strong cruise shore excursion experience, deep knowledge of ports and destination logistics, and a solid understanding of onboard operations. The Manager oversees the full lifecycle of destination experiences — from sourcing and contracting to onboard delivery and financial performance. Your Impact Destination & Product Management

• Own budgeting and revenue performance for assigned regions
• Monitor margins, refund trends, and voyage-level contribution
• Identify underperforming ports and optimize offerings accordingly
• Partner with Finance and Analytics on reporting and dashboards Your Journey so far - 7–10+ years in cruise shore excursions, destination management, or luxury travel - Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or equivalent experience preferred. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer. Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

descriptionByLocale.it: Join our team as a CRM Director, where you will lead data-driven customer engagement programs and lifecycle marketing strategies. Leverage your expertise in CRM and marketing automation to drive commercial growth and enhance customer loyalty. Be part of a vibrant luxury brand redefining the cruise experience!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
